prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. Apply both edits in a single command invocation: (1) in paragraph p1, replace "first" with "primary" and (2) in paragraph p4, replace "useful" with "convenient". Write the result to {output}. Use --author {author} for the new edits. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} has both edits visible in their paragraphs (p1 reads "This is the primary section..." and p4 reads "...which is convenient for articles..."); otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Both paragraphs edited in one atomic batch; sections preserved; no half-state.
